description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin Missiles and Fire Control is hiring an Embedded Software Engineer Asc in Orlando, Florida. The role develops and maintains embedded and desktop software, including requirements, design, coding, testing, integration, and debugging for embedded multi-core systems and sensor and countermeasure emulation applications.
Embedded Software Engineer Asc designing and testing C++ applications, drivers, state machines, and tactical hardware-control software

Responsibilities:
• Develop Embedded Software to include drivers, state machines, multi-threaded applications, etc
• Integrate complex algorithms into C++ applications
• Design, develop, document, test, and debug software for both logical and mathematical solutions as well as software for controlling tactical hardware
• Apply knowledge of computer hardware and software, while referencing Artificial Intelligence in a responsible manner in accordance with Lockheed, contractual, and governmental policies to accelerate documentation, development, and functional tests
• Contribute to detailed design architectures, ensuring architecture and source code remain in alignment

Requirements:
• The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of object-oriented C++ concepts and experience with Linux OS
• Candidates filling this position will need US citizenship
• will need a clearance at the level specified in “Clearance Level” or will need the ability to get a clearance if not specified
• Must have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related software discipline
• Demonstrated software development experience in C++
• Experience working Operating systems / familiarity with OS concepts. This may include: Linux, Windows, Unix, VxWorks, Operating Systems Coursework, etc
• Ability to obtain DoD Clearance
• Must be US Citizen

Preferred:
• Experience working Operating systems / familiarity with OS concepts. This may include: Linux, Windows, Unix, VxWorks, Operating Systems Coursework, etc
• Hardware experience (Arduino, STMxx, Xilinx, any FPGA Programmable Software
• Strong understanding of C++ Object Oriented design and inheritance concepts
• Understanding of basic multi-threading concepts
• Working with large code base
• DevSecOps tool chain experience (this may include Git, GitHub, BitBucket)
• Software configuration management
• Full software life-cycle development
• Software integration and debugging techniques
• Demonstrated software development experience in C / Python
• Familiarity with Agile practices
• Prior embedded internships is a bonus, but not required
